subject: Money
title: NFTs Explained
description: A micro-lesson that makes NFTs Explained usable.

hook.text: Beeple sold a digital image as an NFT for $69 million in 2021. A year later, similar NFTs sold for $5. Wild swings.

buildup.text: NFTs are unique digital tokens proving ownership of a specific item—art, music, or game items—on a blockchain.

discovery.text: The technology is real: verifiable digital ownership without a middleman. The use cases are still being discovered.

twist.text: Over 95% of NFTs minted in 2021 are now worthless. The speculative mania overshadowed the legitimate technology.

climax.text: NFTs may survive as digital tickets, certificates, or gaming items. The art bubble popped, but the concept endures.

punchline.text: The tech works. The hype didn't.

quiz.question: What do NFTs prove?
options: Unique ownership of a digital item on a blockchain
